errors.text_span: приблизително от ~500 към ~400–450 хил. ха в края на периода
errors.evidence: This description combines the trends for Turkey and the USA. The starting point of ~500 thousand hectares is only accurate for Turkey, as the USA starts at approximately 450. The ending range of 400-450 thousand hectares is also not entirely accurate for the USA, which ends below 400 thousand hectares.
